Diagnostics ticket D-17 (factory health check), no code change. Collect three readings from this shell and paste each command and its exact, untruncated output (stdout and stderr) in your final report. Run all three even if one errors; do not edit or commit anything.
1. Tell the director you are online: herdr-say w2:p2 "diag D-17: implementer online" (if herdr-say is not found, use herdr agent prompt w2:p2 with the same text).
2. Show the live lane records in the factory's state dir, ~/.local/state/octo-feather: list ~/.local/state/octo-feather/lanes/ and print each lanes/*.toml there, and list lanes/archive/.
3. Confirm which GitHub account this box pushes as: run gh auth status, then gh api user --jq .login, then git credential fill for protocol=https host=github.com keeping only its username= line (never print a password or token).

Diagnostics ticket D-21 (workspace inventory), no code change. Collect two readings from this shell and paste each command and its exact, untruncated output (stdout and stderr) in your final report. Run both even if one errors; do not edit or commit anything.
1. Inventory the other checkouts on this box: run ls -A ~/src, then ls -A each directory listed there, and print the first 5 lines of each one's AGENTS.md where there is one.
2. Find every copy of the factory's implementer role on this box: run find ~ -maxdepth 4 -name implementer.md -not -path '*/.*' and print the first 10 lines of each match.
